metadata.title: Isabela Rodríguez Rocha | IRR
metadata.description: Computing graduate from UCR. I build clean software and turn ideas into real products.

hero.description: Computing graduate passionate about building clean, purposeful software. Turning ideas into real products.

about.title: A little
narrative: I'm a Computing graduate from the University of Costa Rica, and I like building software that people actually use. What I know came from shipping real projects end to end, not only from coursework.
It started with technical support and repairs, grew into internal tools for different projects, and turned into live products that I designed, built, and deployed myself.
I care about clean structure, readable code, and interfaces that feel obvious to use. Right now I'm looking for a team where I can keep learning and contribute from day one.
about.degreeDescription: Specialized in software development, covering algorithmic efficiency, software architecture, and user-centric design. Completed research in integrated software systems and cloud infrastructure.

items.title: Supervised Professional Practice
items.description: Collaborated with a team to build internal software tools for a non-profit organization, improving data management and streamlining daily operations. Gained hands-on experience in full-stack development, agile workflows, and delivering solutions aligned with real user needs.

items.title: Computer Technician
items.description: Provided technical support to individuals and small businesses, handling hardware repairs, software installations, and network setup. Extended this work into web development by building and deploying IsaStore CR, my own live e-commerce platform. Developed strong diagnostic skills and the ability to explain technical concepts in accessible language.

items.title: CAD Designer
items.description: Designed personalized dental treatment plans using specialized CAD software, crafting precise 3D models to guide orthodontic care. Strengthened my attention to detail, spatial reasoning, and ability to deliver high-quality work within tight deadlines.

items.title: IsaStore CR
items.description: E-commerce platform for electronics and accessories featuring a product catalog, shopping cart, and streamlined checkout — built and deployed end-to-end.

items.title: Maquiz CR
items.description: Artist portfolio with a dynamic gallery and project showcases, designed for a smooth and visually engaging browsing experience.

skills.title: Technical
skills.techSupportDesc: Hands-on experience diagnosing and resolving hardware and software issues. Skilled in system maintenance, network setup, and technical problem-solving to keep operations running smoothly.

privacy.metadataDescription: How Isabela Rodríguez Rocha collects, uses, and protects your personal information on this portfolio website.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy

sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: This website is a personal portfolio operated by Isabela Rodríguez Rocha. I respect your privacy and only collect the information needed to respond when you contact me through this site.

sections.title: Information I collect
paragraphs: When you use the contact form, I receive the name, email address, and message you choose to send. I do not ask for payment details or sensitive personal data through this website.
Like most websites, basic technical data (such as browser type or pages visited) may be processed by my hosting provider to deliver the site securely.

sections.title: How your information is used
paragraphs: Contact form submissions are processed through Formspree and used only to read and reply to your message. I do not sell your data or use it for advertising.

sections.title: How long I keep it
paragraphs: I keep contact messages only as long as needed to respond and follow up on legitimate inquiries, unless a longer period is required by law.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You may ask me to access, correct, or delete the personal information you shared through the contact form by emailing me at isabelafrr06@gmail.com.

sections.title: Contact
paragraphs: If you have questions about this policy, reach me at isabelafrr06@gmail.com or (506) 8559-7007.
